map.由线性衰减系数与厚度求透射强度 使用指南: Transmitted Intensity from Linear Attenuation Coefficient and Thickness User Guide
map.输入 γ 射线初始强度 I₀、线性衰减系数 μ 与穿过物质厚度 x，按 I =: Enter the gamma ray initial intensity I0, the linear attenuation coefficient mu and the thickness x of material passed through, and compute the transmitted intensity as I = I0*e^(-mu*x). Used for shielding design, non-destructive testing and protective thickness selection.
map.输入初始强度 I₀、衰减系数 μ、厚度 x，求透射强度。: Enter initial intensity I0, attenuation coefficient mu and thickness x to find the transmitted intensity.
map.I = I₀·e^(−μx) 穿过厚度 x 的屏蔽后强度。: I = I0*e^(-mu*x), the intensity after passing through a shield of thickness x.
map.对比不同线性衰减系数 μ 的效果。: Compare the effect of different linear attenuation coefficients mu.
map.：若 x=10cm，则 I=100×e⁻¹≈36.79，厚度翻倍强度降到约 37: : If x = 10 cm, then I = 100 x e^-1, about 36.79; doubling the thickness drops the intensity to about 37%.
map.由核数与活度反推半衰期: Half-life from number of nuclei and activity
map.线性衰减系数（cm⁻¹），与材料和射线能量有关，值越大屏蔽越强。: Linear attenuation coefficient (cm^-1), related to material and radiation energy; the larger the value the stronger the shielding.
map.半值层怎么算？: How is the half-value layer computed?
map.半值层 x₁/₂ = ln2/μ，本例 μ=0.1 时约 6.93cm。: Half-value layer x_1/2 = ln2/mu, about 6.93 cm in this example with mu = 0.1.
